home.title: Final Fantasy XIV
home.intro: Welcome to Final Fantasy XIV. Look up items, market listings, character Logs, and calendar events here. Open Module settings to change defaults or source credentials.
home.manual: Queries run only when submitted. This response shows any missing data, failures, and coverage limits reported by the source.
home.globalSettings: Manage the master key, storage recovery, global theme, and fonts in Global settings.
settings.title: Module settings
settings.subscriptionDefaults: Defaults apply to future subscriptions. Existing subscriptions keep their settings. Reminders are checked on a schedule and may arrive late.
settings.themeUnavailable: This theme is unavailable. Choose another.
settings.credentialsScope: China and Global use separate credentials. Saving credentials does not verify access to FFLogs.
settings.credentialStorage: Saved credentials are hidden. Manage encrypted storage in Global settings.
settings.authorizationLost: Management authorization or the module binding is no longer valid. Reopen this page.
settings.writeUnverified: Submitted. Refresh to verify the current status.
settings.invalidInput: Input was rejected. Check the fields and credential format.
settings.conflict: The settings changed in another operation. You can keep editing the draft. Refresh before saving.
settings.operationUnknown: The operation could not be verified. Refresh the status before trying again. It will not retry automatically.
settings.invalidStored: Some settings are invalid. The original values were kept. Correct them before saving.
settings.loaded: Settings loaded. Source access remains unverified after saving credentials.
settings.savedWithDraft: Your submission was saved. Newer edits are still unsaved.
settings.saved: Saved. Run a query to verify source access.
settings.stopped: Stopped waiting. The operation may have been saved. Refresh to check.
settings.discardedStale: Local changes were discarded. Refresh before saving.
settings.selectTheme: Choose an available reply theme or follow global settings.
settings.checkFields: Check the subscription toggle, region, days, delivery time, and sync interval.
settings.invalidTimezone: Enter a valid IANA time zone.
settings.invalidCredential: Enter both credentials. Each may contain up to 512 characters, excluding control characters.
settings.bindingLost: The module or its authorization changed. Reopen this page.
query.items.title: Item lookup
query.market.title: Market prices
query.logs.title: Character Logs
query.calendar.title: Event calendar
query.items.hint: Search by name or ID. Missing fields and source notes appear in the results.
query.market.hint: Leave the scope blank to search all worlds in the server's default region. The server also resolves names and scope aliases.
query.logs.hint: Select the region and world, then enter the character name. An administrator manages source credentials outside the public page.
query.calendar.hint: Queries for the selected window run only when submitted. See this response for source failures or coverage limits.
query.ready: Module catalog loaded. The server checks authorization for every query. Queries run only when submitted.
query.unavailable: The current page status could not be verified. Refresh the status. If the problem persists, sign in to Dashboard again or reopen this page.
query.field.serverExample: World ID or exact world name
query.status.timeout: Stopped waiting after {seconds} seconds. The request may still be running. Check your session and the source before trying again manually.
query.status.requestFailed: The query did not finish. Check your sign-in, web address, and input before trying again manually. You can sign in to Dashboard again, check the web address under the plugin's settings gear, save, reload the plugin, and reopen this page.
query.status.stopped: Stopped showing results. The request may still be running in the background. It will not retry automatically.
query.status.bindingLost: The page binding changed. Reopen this page.
query.status.refreshStopped: Refreshing the status stopped the pending results from being shown. The request may still be running. Check the status before submitting again manually.
query.validation.requiredItemName: Enter a name or ID, up to {limit} characters.
query.validation.requiredItem: Enter an item name or ID, up to {limit} characters.
query.validation.requiredWorld: Enter a world, up to {limit} characters.
query.validation.requiredCharacter: Enter a character name, up to {limit} characters.
query.validation.requiredTimezone: Enter an IANA time zone, up to {limit} characters.
query.validation.quality: Select all qualities, NQ, or HQ.
query.validation.intent: Select Overview, Lowest price, or Active listings.
query.validation.scopeLength: Enter up to 100 characters for the scope.
query.validation.optionalRegion: Select China or Global, or leave it blank for the server default scope.
query.validation.days: Enter a whole number from 1 to 30 for the number of days.
query.validation.timezone: Enter a valid IANA time zone, such as Asia/Shanghai.
query.error.parameter_error: The source rejected the parameters. If the scope is ambiguous, use a specific World ID or official data center name.
query.error.auth_required: Source credentials are unavailable. Ask an administrator to configure them for the selected region.
query.error.auth_expired: Authorization expired. Sign in to Dashboard again.
query.error.rate_limited: The query was rate limited. Try again manually later.
query.error.module_unavailable: The module or query window is unavailable. Refresh the status and try again manually.
query.error.upstream_error: The data source is temporarily unavailable. Try again manually later.
query.error.not_found: The source found no match. Check the name or ID.
query.error.no_records: The source returned no records. Full coverage of the search window has not been established.
query.error.not_public: The source content is not publicly available.
query.error.fallback: The query did not finish. Check the input and the source before trying again manually.
query.result.title: Results
query.result.emptyTable: The source returned an empty table.
query.result.emptyDocument: The source returned no content to display.
query.result.select: Select an item from the results
query.result.stopNote: Stopping hides the result. The request may still run in the background.
query.result.pickCandidate: Select an item from the current results. Editing the input or submitting again clears these matches.
query.result.truncatedCandidates: Some matches are omitted. Enter a more specific name and submit again.
market.truncated: Some results are omitted. Only the limited set of listings returned for this query is shown.
